question: Driven by the phone's own frame intervals instead of a constant 16.667 ms, does the model predict what binding h did on the phone?
verdict: YES on both frame-traced nights. At each night's own seed, frame trace and clock-derived phase the model survives, and the phone did: night6-ft-01 (seed 24926, one candidate) survived all 335 s before the executor stopped on an ambiguous gate read, and night6-tw-04 (seed 24883 or 24884) reached 6 AM with 41 of 42 gates agreed. On both, the survival band runs from 175 ms early to 50 ms late of the clock-derived phase at 25 ms resolution, and the game's own phase sits about 30-37 ms late of it: inside the band, with thin margin on the late side.
